title: Son Biography — 2005–2014 Reconstructed Corridor
purpose: Expose the recovered ordinary-life chronology between the 2005 crash and the 2014 death of the earthly father without replacing the specialist chronology owners. Preferred years remain distinguishable from exact dates.

events.title: Reconstruction continues after the crash
events.subject: Son
events.summary: Dental/facial reconstruction, school disruption, shame, depression and gradual rebuilding continue across years after the 2005 motorcycle crash; this is a process rather than one surgery date.
events.confidence: high for multi-year process; exact procedure dates unresolved

events.title: Painter / decorator work
events.subject: Son
events.summary: Preferred working placement for the practical painting/decorating period. Current recollection firmly places this before meatpacking and before Copenhagen IT.

events.title: Meatpacking / freezer / forklift period
events.subject: Son
events.summary: Months of meatpacking and freezer/forklift work follow painting/decorating. The sequence is secure even though exact employment dates are not recovered.

events.title: Copenhagen interview — hired on the spot
events.subject: Son
events.summary: After applying for more work, the Son goes to Copenhagen for an IT-consultant interview and remembers being hired immediately with the practical question of whether he could start Monday.

events.title: Rapid move to Copenhagen / IT consulting
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The job produces an almost-overnight move to Copenhagen and a corporate IT-consulting period. The abrupt transition is now a key place-and-work anchor in the biography.

events.title: Fired from IT job → return to Haderslev
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The Copenhagen period ends with firing; the Son returns to the Haderslev home base. This return must precede the nursing-home job.

events.title: Nursing-home work in the Haderslev corridor
events.subject: Son
events.summary: Preferred working placement for the care-work period after Copenhagen and before Designia/Kolding. The Son remembers not yet having a driver's licence during this job.

events.title: Own apartment in Haderslev
events.subject: Son
events.summary: After returning from Copenhagen and during/after the nursing-home period, the Son remembers moving into his own apartment in Haderslev before applying to design school.

events.title: Designia application — mailed circus-poster collage
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The Son applies to HANSENBERG Designia / mediegrafiker by constructing a circus poster from coloured cardstock/paper and mailing the physical collage to the school; he remembers being accepted afterward.

events.title: Summer move to Kolding / Designia mediegrafiker
events.subject: Son
events.summary: Preferred placement for the summer move into Kolding student housing/dormitory and start of the mediegrafiker path at HANSENBERG Designia.

events.title: Louise relationship begins in Kolding
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The relationship begins after the Kolding move. It becomes a major chronological rail for Egypt, the internship, Aabenraa and the later breakup corridor.

events.title: Egypt trip while relationship with Louise is active
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The Egypt trip is now constrained to after meeting Louise and while the relationship was active. Its exact date and whether it precedes or follows the Aabenraa internship remain unresolved.

events.title: Living with Louise and her parents
events.subject: Son
events.summary: Before the Aabenraa internship move, the Son remembers living with Louise and her parents in Kolding.
events.confidence: direct relative recollection; exact dates unresolved

events.title: Internship / office placement → move to Aabenraa
events.subject: Son
events.summary: Preferred working placement for the draining office/cubicle internship period. The Son moves to Aabenraa to be closer to the placement while continuing to commute to Louise in Kolding.

events.title: Design/internship path ends → own place
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The school/internship path fails or ends; the Son remembers moving into his own place while the relationship with Louise continued for at least some time. The city of this apartment remains unresolved.

events.title: Produktionsskolen in Lunderskov
events.subject: Son
events.summary: After the own-place transition, the Son attends Produktionsskolen in Lunderskov. Exact start/end dates remain unresolved, but attendance ends before the 2011 Tree/psychiatric sequence.

events.title: Informal assistant-teacher role in multimedia class
events.subject: Son
events.summary: While still formally a student, the Son remembers functioning as an informal assistant teacher during multimedia lessons because his existing technical level was ahead of much of the class material. This is practical competence, not a formal teaching credential.

events.title: Produktionsskolen ends before the Tree episode
events.subject: Son
events.summary: Direct recollection fixes a useful boundary: the Son had already stopped attending Produktionsskolen before the 2011 Tree/psychiatric episode.

events.title: Breakup and search corridor before the Tree ordeal
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The Louise breakup and collapse of direction precede the psychonaut/Tree period. Its exact relation to the end of Produktionsskolen remains open.
events.confidence: high before-Tree relation; unresolved vs Produktionsskolen

events.title: Sleep → next-day perceptual rupture
events.subject: Son
events.summary: After the prolonged altered-state ordeal and sleep, ordinary boundaries do not fully return; a shopping trip becomes overwhelming with noise and apparent inner voices. This is post-acute and should not be silently merged into the main trip.

events.title: Voluntary psychiatric presentation / admission
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The Son voluntarily presents for psychiatric care so the brain can rest and move back toward baseline. Current reconstruction therefore supersedes wording that implies a forced pause or involuntary capture.

events.title: Hospital dream / crow scene as later phases
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The nuclear-America dream/vision and later dense crow/crowd scene belong to the hospital/aftermath sequence rather than being compressed into the acute psychedelic event.

events.title: Italy with earthly father / Maria corridor
events.subject: Son
events.summary: Two-week Italy trip with the earthly father and meeting Maria remain the preferred 2012 integration-period reconstruction. Exact dates and primary travel artifacts remain recovery targets.

events.title: 25th birthday in Amsterdam
events.subject: Son
events.summary: If the remembered 25th-birthday Amsterdam event is accurate, the birth anchor fixes the date mathematically to July 31, 2012. This is one of the strongest conditional exact dates in the pre-2014 corridor.
events.confidence: high conditional on autobiographical birthday memory

events.title: Guitar from father / new musical channel
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The father gifts a guitar during the 2012 integration period. Use 'first personally owned guitar' or 'first guitar from his father' because earlier bass/guitar exposure already exists in the biography.

events.title: The Alchemist enters as transmutation metaphor
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The preferred chronology places Paulo Coelho's The Alchemist in 2013, where fracture-to-gold/transmutation language becomes an explicit interpretive resource. A primary artifact would strengthen the date.
